summary: This Form 6-K reports the outcome of an extraordinary general meeting of LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer. The filing states which proposals passed and which did not, without disclosing the specific proposal content. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine corporate governance update regarding shareholder voting results. It does not constitute a special situation.
